critical_code_review_comments: useNovaTypewriter.ts hook is correctly scoped: only animates when fresh.length === 1 AND fresh[0].role === 'assistant' AND prevLastRole === 'user'. This precisely satisfies the 'only new assistant reply to a user message' requirement — history-loaded and seeded assistant openings render instantly (verified: no cursor testid appeared on fresh /help load).

Interval-based reveal with step = ceil(total / (durationMs/40ms)) yields deterministic frame count. Verified growth samples in French help reply (327 chars): 9→25→41→57→77→...→313 (Δ~16 chars per 40ms tick, ~3.3s total), respecting the 600ms–3500ms clamp.
getVisibleContent and cursor node co-located inside the same <Text> ensures inline appearance of '▍' immediately after partial text, which the screenshot confirms visually.

Skip-to-full via onPress={typewriter.isAnimating(msg) ? typewriter.skip : undefined}: verified live — clicking the streaming bubble grew visible text from 37 → 997 chars and removed the cursor node in a single tick, exactly as expected.

Action pills gate on !typewriter.isAnimating(msg): verified — audio-button, feedback-up, feedback-down, favorite-toggle are ALL absent while the cursor testid is present, and ALL appear after cursor disappears (post-reveal DOM check confirmed all 3 pills for the primary message).
Timer cleanup on unmount (useEffect cleanup + skip clearInterval) is present; no leaked intervals observed across 3 nav cycles (Help → Settings → Help).
